# Hash-pinned requirements for the "Install zizmor" step in actionlint.yml,
# which installs this file with --require-hashes. A version pin alone still
# installs whatever artifact the index serves for that version; these sha256
# hashes make the install the same bytes on every run.
#
# The hashes below are the wheels pip resolves on the ubuntu-latest runner
# platform: x86_64 glibc, CPython 3.13. zizmor declares no runtime
# dependencies, so PyYAML is the whole transitive closure.
#
# The `pip` entry in .github/dependabot.yml watches this directory, so a
# version bump arrives as a pull request with the --hash lines rewritten
# beside it. Its hash set is every artifact the release ships rather than
# this platform's, and --require-hashes accepts a superset. To regenerate
# the hashes for this platform by hand instead of copying them from a
# release page --
#
#   python3 -m pip download -d /tmp/req-dl zizmor==<new> PyYAML==<new>
#   sha256sum /tmp/req-dl/*
#
# then rewrite the --hash lines from that output. If a bump introduces a
# new transitive dependency, add a requirement line for it too:
# hash-checking mode still resolves dependencies and refuses any it cannot
# pin, so a dep the file omits fails the install loudly -- the sha256sum
# output above lists every artifact in the closure.
# The workflow's `.github/workflows/**` path filter re-runs this gate when
# the file changes.

zizmor==1.29.0 \
    --hash=sha256:587b99c2e1b34575c6c8565c2bfde415ca8bc0310f5589f19bc948c8dea10a20
PyYAML==6.0.3 \
    --hash=sha256:0f29edc409a6392443abf94b9cf89ce99889a1dd5376d94316ae5145dfedd5d6
